stock.description: Headquartered in Guangzhou, People's Republic of China, Clifford Modern Living Holdings Limited, an investment holding company established in 1998, delivers a broad spectrum of services across the PRC. Its operations are divided into six principal segments: Property Management, Renovation and Fitting-Out, Retail, Off-Campus Training, Information Technology, and Ancillary Living Services. The company's retail footprint comprises 18 outlets, specifically two supermarkets, a wet market, and fifteen convenience stores. Clifford provides comprehensive property management and resident support solutions for both residential complexes and commercial properties. Its renovation and fitting-out capabilities extend to residents, tenants, property owners, and even third-party subcontractors. Additionally, Clifford offers off-campus training programs, encompassing various interest classes and language learning courses. The Information Technology segment covers IT and related engineering services, security system implementation, hardware and software integration, and telecommunication sales. Further ancillary services include catering consultancy, real estate agency, employment placement, and laundry services. All these offerings are provided to customers under the "Clifford" brand.
